{{External|rs=Hidey-holes}}
[[File:S.T.A.S.H chart built.png|left|120px]]
[[File:STASH unit.png|thumb|Interacting with a STASH unit.]]
'''STASH''' (short for "'''Store Things And Stuff Here'''") are storage units for [[emote clue]] items, saving [[bank]] space and time for players who frequent [[Treasure Trails]]. While beginner-tier clues can be done in [[free-to-play]], only [[member]]s can make use of these units as they require use of the [[Construction]] skill.

There are a total of {{#var_final:STASHcount}} constructible STASH units throughout [[Gielinor]]. All these locations are initially labelled as "inconspicuous bushes/crates/holes/rocks" and, once built, become usable STASH units. Players can see which units they've already constructed and filled via a [[S.t.a.s.h chart]] in the [[study]] of a [[player-owned house]], or by reading the [[Noticeboard (Watson's house)|noticeboard]] within [[Watson's house]].

==Materials==
The materials and level required to construct a STASH unit from an inconspicuous object depend on the tier of the related clue scroll. These levels can be [[Construction#Temporary boosts|boosted]]. 

Players require any [[hammer]] and [[saw]] to construct these units. The type of [[nails]] used is irrelevant, however all ten nails must be made of the same metal. Since nails cannot be bent while constructing STASH units, it's advised to use the cheapest possible nails. Notably, [[dragon nail|dragon nails]] do '''not''' work.

==Stashing items==
Interacting with a constructed STASH unit allows the player to stash the related [[emote clue]] items in it. It's only possible to stash the full set of items required for the emote clue, not individual parts of it. [[(g)|Gilded]], [[(or)|ornamented]], and other variants of required items can be used and stashed in place unless stated otherwise. Other items cannot be stashed in these storage units.

Enabling the "STASH units take equipped items" setting in the [[Settings]] menu allows the player to directly store equipped emote clue items without having to unequip them first. In case the player has more than one of a storable item, those in the inventory take priority over those equipped.

Items can be taken out of a filled STASH unit by interacting with it again, as long as the player has enough inventory space to take out all stashed items at once.

==Changes==
{{Subject changes header}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 17 December 2025
|update = More Sailing and Interface Changes
|change = The STASH unit at the Lava Maze now allow you to deposit equipped items that are required for its clue step.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 1 October 2025
|update = Interface Uplift Round 2
|change = Equipped items can now be deposited directly into STASH units, if the new "STASH units take equipped items" setting is enabled in the Settings menu.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 2 October 2024
|update = Rewards and XP Improvements - Varlamore: The Rising Darkness
|change = Added S.T.A.S.H. units that were missing from three new Treasure Trail steps at the Twilight Temple, and where the River Ortus meets the Proudspire.

==Trivia==
* STASH units were referred to as '''Hidey Holes''' in the blogposts and poll proposing the system be added to the game. While this name is used in ''[[rsw:Hidey-holes|RuneScape 3]]'' for the name of its equivalent of the STASH unit system, it is not used in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]''.
